title: How to use native advertising on social media | Native Advertising Institute

facts.fact: The page states that teens' daily screen time was 8 hours and 39 minutes at the outset of 2023, and that roughly half of all screen time goes to social media.
facts.quote: teens’ daily screen time at 8 hours and 39 minutes at the outset of 2023

facts.fact: According to DataReport, 1.32 million active users can be reached by advertising on Instagram.
facts.quote: A whopping [1.32 million active users can be reached by advertising on Instagram]

facts.fact: According to Instagram's business site, 90% of the platform's users follow at least one brand.
facts.quote: 90% of the platform’s users follow at least one brand

facts.fact: Citing Forrester research, the page claims users are ten times as likely to engage with brands on Instagram as on Facebook.
facts.quote: users are ten times as likely to engage with brands on Instagram ten times more than they are on Facebook.

facts.fact: In the McDonald's Denmark influencer case study, the campaign generated over nine million impressions.
facts.quote: The campaign generated over nine million impressions

facts.fact: In the same McDonald's case study, the campaign generated half a million votes and more than 30,000 clicks on the McDonald's app.
facts.quote: half a million votes and more than 30,000 clicks on the McDonald’s app
